title: 018 寻找梅林家族线索-《第19次末日》
content:
第(1/3)页

    说完两人都消失在了空间内部，空间又回归了安静只有风不时吹过草地发出的声音，另一个世界灵魂重新分裂后都陷入了昏睡状态，在夜星和夜辰的脑海内都出现了一部非常完善的功法。

    而在旁边，一名气度非凡的老人候立在一旁，格里芬皇朝的二把手，有着‘立地皇帝’一称的总司神态凝重的看着荧幕里的秦铮。

    陆峥点头，他曾经修行过太极斩尊枪，对于太极天帝的气息十分熟悉，此刻再次掌握了太极轮回天，更是明悟了太极的真谛。

    荆棘星中，十几艘战斗舰升入宇宙，而在星球留守的第七舰队看到属于自家舰队的战斗舰升空，明显就愣住了。

    “我问菲尔德纳维诺星的事情，是不是你干的！”屈铁戾厉声问着。

    他实在是太惊讶了，没想到在这里竟然能够见到曾经来找过他，自己送出巫族传承的仙滢滢。

    虽然郭天旭就是他的儿子，但是郭子兴却不知道郭天旭的真实想法。

    其实，司徒山猜的很对，这李天意可是在短短十年中，从结丹期直接窜到了元婴巅峰。

    虽然这剑令比不上龙九渊五人持有的操控整个大剑宗中枢的五行剑令，但也仅比其弱一点。

    旗舰被他当成了诱饵，而果然如他所料的，那些包围的飞船根本就不管什么信号，径直攻击。

    元笑陷入沉思，这些事情，白童童从没有告诉过自己。但是，想一想，若是告诉了自己，也改变不了什么。

    到了南天门前，阡陌想起了他生平难忘的那次撕衣服和买衣服的事情。

    西流月神情一愣，不负刚才的喜悦，眼眸黯淡下来，如同一朵艳丽的花忽然间凋谢。

    温热气息如数全喷在她的脸上，如野兽般令人惊悚的黑眸正紧锁着她，似要把她撕裂撕碎。

    既然他这么喜欢这个地方，那么她离开好了。反正已经决定离开A市，现在不过是将计划提前。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

After saying that, both of them disappeared into the space, and the space returned to silence with only the sound of the wind blowing through the grass from time to time. After the souls of the other world were re-divided, they both fell into a comatose state. A very complete technique appeared in the minds of Ye Xing and Ye Chen.

Next to him, an old man with extraordinary bearing was standing aside. The second-in-command of the Griffin Dynasty, the chief executive, known as the "Emperor of the Earth", looked at Qin Zheng on the screen with a solemn expression.

Lu Zheng nodded. He had practiced the Tai Chi Zunzhan Spear and was very familiar with the aura of the Tai Chi Heavenly Emperor. Now he had mastered the Tai Chi Reincarnation Heaven again and understood the true meaning of Tai Chi.

In the Thorn Star, more than a dozen battleships ascended into the universe, and the Seventh Fleet, which was left behind on the planet, was obviously stunned when they saw the battleships belonging to their own fleet taking off.

"I asked Feld about the Navino star, if it was you who did it!" Qu Tieru asked sharply.

He was really surprised. He didn't expect to see Xian Yingying, who had come to him before and gave away the inheritance of the witch clan.

Although Guo Tianxu is his son, Guo Zixing doesn't know Guo Tianxu's true thoughts.

In fact, Situ Shan’s guess was correct. Li Tianyi had gone from the Dan Formation stage to the peak of Nascent Soul in just ten years.

Although this sword order is not as good as the Five Elements Sword Order held by Long Jiuyuan and the other five who control the center of the entire Great Sword Sect, it is only slightly weaker than it.

He used the flagship as a bait, and just as he expected, the surrounding spacecraft ignored any signal and attacked directly.

Yuan Xiao fell into deep thought. Bai Tongtong had never told him these things.But, think about it, if you tell yourself, it won't change anything.

Arriving in front of Nantian Gate, Qian Mo thought of the unforgettable time in his life when he tore off and bought clothes.

west Liuyue's expression was stunned, and her eyes dimmed, just like a beautiful flower that suddenly withered.

The warm breath was sprayed on her face, and the terrifying black eyes like a beast were locked on her, as if they were going to tear her apart.

Since he likes this place so much, then she should leave.Anyway, I have decided to leave city A, now I am just moving my plan forward.
